name: Managed IT + HIPAA security compliance for independent dental & vet practices — Chicago North Side
summary: Flat monthly managed IT (RMM, patching, EDR, backup, network, imaging/PM-software support, same-day on-site within ~5 miles) plus annual HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis and policies, for independent dental and companion-animal vet practices of 5-15 workstations in Lakeview / North Center / Lincoln Square / Logan Square / Lincoln Park / Ravenswood. Founder is the first technician. Customers = practices; technician labor is capacity-triggered staff, so gross margin covers only per-practice tool and storage costs.
evidence_notes: Published dental-MSP prices: Siotek $399/mo flat (~10 workstations, 4 on-site visits/yr) [B, C6-S007]; Darkhorse $422/$749 for 15 workstations ($28-50/workstation) [B, C6-S006]; Chicago directory market range $500-2,000/mo retainer [D, DD-S019].

Base price $700/practice/month = 10 workstations x $60 + $100 HIPAA compliance layer (annual risk analysis, policies, staff training, documentation). Above remote flat-rate rivals because it includes same-day on-site response and the compliance work they reserve for custom tiers (C6-S007).

Tool costs: Syncro RMM/PSA $129-179 per technician/month with unlimited endpoints [B, DD-S017]; Backblaze B2 $6.95/TB-month [B, DD-S018]; EDR, email security and DNS filtering per-endpoint prices not retrieved (E, ~$6-8/endpoint).
Technician cost: Illinois computer user support specialist median $59,860 (Chicago $60,730) [C, C6-S026], loaded x1.3 = ~$78k. One technician per ~28 practices (~300 endpoints) is an assumption (E).

Client loss: Illinois DSO affiliation +0.4 pts/yr (12.7% -> 13.9%, 2022-25) and dental establishment decline ~0.7%/yr [C, C6-S001..S004]; base churn 1%/month includes practice sales and switching (E).

Demand trigger: HIPAA Security Rule NPRM (Jan 2025) would mandate asset inventories, MFA, encryption and annual compliance audits; still a proposed rule as of 2026-11-28 [A, DD-S020] - a sales tailwind, not a mandate.
Funnel conversion rates and lead volumes are E. Founder draw $4,000/month from month 13 (cross-model convention).

drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with owner/office manager per month (walk-ins within the radius, equipment-dealer and broker referrals, study clubs) while founder also does technical work.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free network + HIPAA gap assessment -> written proposal.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Newcomer vs incumbent IT provider; switching costs moderate (C6-S007 12-month terms).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Peer/study-club referrals common in dentistry (Stage C, E).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: IL DSO drift ~0.4 pts/yr + establishment decline ~0.7%/yr (C6-S001..S004) + switching (E).
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Comparable published $399-749/practice (C6-S006, C6-S007); local $500-2,000 (DD-S019). Base = 10 WS x $60 + $100 compliance.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Onboarding/remediation project (firewall, backup target, documentation, first risk analysis).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Per-practice tools ~11 endpoints x $6-12 (EDR, email/DNS security, compliance portal; E) + backup ~2 TB x $6.95 (DD-S018). Technician labor is in staff, RMM/PSA in overhead.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, local search, dental/vet society sponsorships.
drivers.dso_days__source: Billed monthly in advance on autopay (Stage A); negative = prepaid.
